mechanics.title: Beacon range
mechanics.description: Base range (default 10 blocks) plus range per pyramid level (default 10); optional per-block range.

mechanics.title: Conduit range
mechanics.description: Can add to or replace the vanilla range, with range per frame block.

mechanics.title: Beam control
mechanics.description: A carpet on top of the beacon stops beam rendering; tinted glass can show and hide the beam.

vanilla_changes.change: Ranges are configurable (base range, per level, per block).

editor_notes: Defaults appear to match vanilla beacon range (10 + 10 per level), so the pack's actual config values matter; they were not checked. Beam toggle behavior with tinted glass is only vaguely described.
name: Beacon & Conduit Tweaks
summary: Makes beacon and conduit range configurable. Also lets you hide a beacon's beam by placing a carpet on top, or toggle it with tinted glass. Made by the pack author.
